local_incidence_proof.q_divides_P: M is a q-unit and Lminus=Lplus=M^2*U mod q, so q divides either L iff q divides U; Fminus/Fplus squareness forces the three valuation parities U,Lminus,Lplus to agree
local_incidence_proof.q_divides_M: P is a q-unit and Lminus=-P^2*V, Lplus=P^2*V mod q, so q divides either L iff q divides V; squareness forces the three valuation parities V,Lminus,Lplus to agree
local_incidence_proof.q_divides_D0: P^2=M^2 mod q, hence Lminus=M^2*(U-V) and Lplus=M^2*(U+V) mod q; a nonzero parity can occur only in the minus pair or the plus pair
local_incidence_proof.q_outside_C0D0: 36-09AC pairwise support control leaves q in at most one factor of each four-factor product, so its valuation parity must vanish
